name: anim_embrace
subject: a pink goo crocodile monster and a pink goo Doberman monster embracing each other with a small black witch cat squashed between their chests
desc: Loop: the two goo monsters squeeze each other tighter and grind their broad chests together from both sides, slowly and stickily, their bodies squishing and bulging; the trapped cat wriggles and kicks between them; thick goo strands stretch and snap and drip. Heavy, sticky, viscous.
